value.body: A development sector associate works with NGOs, foundations and government-supported social programmes on projects in health, education, livelihoods and similar areas. Employers include NGOs, CSR foundations, research and evaluation organisations and international agencies. A typical day may involve field visits, coordinating with communities and partners, collecting data and writing reports.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.A. Sociology, Political Science, Economics, Social Work; MSW or M.A. Development common

items.label: Work settings
items.value: Field offices, district programmes, head offices

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually enter through fellowships, internships or programme associate roles in NGOs and CSR foundations. Fieldwork experience and a regional language are often expected.

value.title: At a glance
items: Many roles are project-funded and on fixed-term contracts.
Next roles: programme officer, programme manager, M&E specialist.
A master's (MSW or development studies) is common for moving up.
